issue_desc_en: The user reported that their phone fell into a sink while washing dishes. The device is unresponsive and shows signs of internal corrosion.
Customer claims the screen cracked while the device was in a bag, but provided no photos of the bag or surrounding items to corroborate the pressure damage.
Device sustained impact damage during a hiking trip. The customer provided a timestamped photo of the trail, but the damage description is inconsistent with the impact point.
Customer reported the device stolen from a locked locker at the gym. No police report was provided, and the find-my-device logs show the phone was active 2 hours after the reported theft.
The device was dropped on a hardwood floor while the user was playing with their dog. The frame is bent and the display is shattered.
